checks.text: The page displays the heading "Personal Wiki" and, with no notes, shows the text "No notes yet".

Typing "Meeting Notes" in the field labelled "Title" and clicking the button "New note" adds a list item containing "Meeting Notes" and switches to the editor view with the field labelled "Content" focused.

In the editor, typing "# Hello\n- [ ] Task 1\n- [x] Task 2" in the field labelled "Content" and clicking the tab "Preview" shows the rendered text "Hello", a checkbox labelled "Task 1" that is unchecked, and a checkbox labelled "Task 2" that is checked.
In the Preview tab, clicking the checkbox labelled "Task 1" updates the underlying Markdown so that the line "- [ ] Task 1" becomes "- [x] Task 1", and the checkbox is now checked.

With the note "Meeting Notes" open, clicking the button "Export HTML" copies the string "

Hello

  • Task 1
  • Task 2
" to the clipboard.
In the note list, clicking the button "Delete Meeting Notes" removes the note; the list shows "No notes yet" and the editor view is hidden.

Creating a note titled "Second Note" and typing "Link to [[Meeting Notes]]" in Content, then switching to Preview, shows a clickable link with the text "Meeting Notes"; clicking it opens the "Meeting Notes" note in the editor.
Typing "abc" in the field labelled "Search" filters the note list to show only notes whose title contains "abc"; clearing the search field restores all notes.
Reload keeps the note titled "Meeting Notes" with the content "# Hello\n- [x] Task 1\n- [x] Task 2" and the list item "Meeting Notes" visible.
